subject: general
question: X can work as fast as Y and Z together. X and Y together can finish the same task 3 times as fast as Z. If all three working together can finish the task in 15 days, how many days, will Z take to finish the task?
solution:
**Given:**

X can work as fast as Y and Z together.

X and Y together can finish the task 3 times as fast as Z.

All three working together finishes the work in 15 days.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let x, y and z be the per day work rate of X, Y and Z respectively.

⇒ According to the question,

⇒ x = y + z &nbs
